lines.en: How many cards did the writer send?
lines.zh: 作者寄了多少张明信片？
明信片总是破坏我的假期。

lines.en: Last summer, I went to Italy.
lines.zh: 去年夏天，我去了意大利。

lines.en: I visited museums and sat in public gardens.
lines.zh: 我参观了博物馆，并坐在公共花园里。

lines.en: A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
lines.zh: 一位友好的服务员教了我几句意大利语。

lines.en: Then he lent me a book.
I read a few lines, but I did not understand a word.
lines.zh: 我读了几行，但一个字也看不懂。

lines.en: but I did not send cards to my friends.
lines.zh: 但我没有给朋友们寄明信片。

lines.en: On the last day I made a big decision.
lines.zh: 在最后一天，我做了一个重大决定。

lines.en: I got up early and bought thirty-seven cards.
lines.zh: 我起得很早，买了三十七张明信片。

lines.en: I spent the whole day in my room,
lines.zh: 我在房间里待了一整天，

lines.en: but I did not write a single card!
lines.zh: 但我一张明信片也没写！
